evidence_excerpts: The paper reports that, after correcting computed energies for experimental errors, the equilibrium bond length was R = 92.3±0.1 pm with ground-state electronic energy E = -2.865±0.008 MJ mol^-1.
More than 96% of the experimental data are reported to fall within chemical accuracy relative to theoretical values.
text: The photonic variational eigensolver experimentally recovered the He-H+ bond-dissociation curve, finding an equilibrium bond length of 92.3±0.1 pm and a ground-state electronic energy of -2.865±0.008 MJ mol^-1 after correction.
